description: Collection of 17 structured-thinking agent skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents: five whys, first principles, systems thinking, pre-mortem, SWOT, trade-off analysis, six thinking hats and more, with install guides per agent.
rules: Install every skill with npx skills add ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills, or one skill with --skill <name>; skill names match the folders under skills/.
Start with the thinking-method-selector skill when it is unclear which method fits a problem.
